recession.label: Recessions
recession.description: NBER-dated economic downturns across the US economy.

bear.label: Stock crashes (20%+)
bear.description: S&P 500 drops 20% or more from its prior all-time high to its trough.

joblessjump.label: Unemployment jumps
joblessjump.description: Unemployment rate climbs 1.0 pt or more above its 12-month low.

inflation.label: Inflation spikes
inflation.description: Consumer price inflation rises above 5% year-over-year.

housing.label: Home prices falling
housing.description: Case-Shiller national home price index falls year-over-year.

fedcuts.label: Fed starts cutting
fedcuts.description: Federal funds rate drops 0.5 pt or more below its 12-month high.
